title: Gulper Pelican Eel
subtitle: Distensible Pelican Jaw & Luminous Whip-Tail
description: Eurypharynx pelecanoides abyssal morphology displaying a cavernous hinged jaw and distensible pouch capable of swallowing large prey, paired with a bioluminescent caudal whip-tail.
mathNotation: \mathbf{p}_{\text{pouch}}(\theta, t) = \begin{bmatrix} L_x \cos\theta \\ L_y \sin\theta \left[ 1 + \delta \sin(\omega t) \right] \end{bmatrix}, \quad y_{\text{tail}}(s, t) = A_w s^{1.5} \sin(\omega_t t - k s)
